faces.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING

"'Operation LION'S TOOTH.' This is what the Soviets call their MEDUSA deployment plan, and we need to know more. A Soviet spy posing as a businessman, last seen in Sydney, has this information. Find him.

Your second objective is to dig deeper into PEARL compound; locate and sabotage the MEDUSA manufacturing equipment. Finally, Sabik is laying low, but many of his allies are parting ways with him. Find one."

Open the following doors:
U 39 42 S
